connect.label: Identification & Connection
connect.description: Check cable/Bluetooth connection and hardware chipset authenticity
connect.guideAction: Connect the controller via USB cable or Bluetooth and press any button.
connect.guidePass: Connection indicator turns green and confirmation button is pressed (✕ / A).
connect.guideTip: A USB cable connection provides the lowest latency and highest polling rate.

action_btns.label: Action Buttons
action_btns.description: Test the 4 action buttons (✕ ◯ □ △ / A B X Y)
action_btns.guideTitle: Action Buttons (✕ ◯ □ △ / A B X Y)
action_btns.guideAction: Press each highlighted button on the controller in sequence.
action_btns.guidePass: Press and verify all 4 action buttons.
action_btns.guideTip: Buttons should bounce back smoothly; stiffness indicates worn conductive pads.

dpad.label: Directional Pad (D-Pad)
dpad.description: Test the 4 directions of the D-Pad (Up, Right, Down, Left)
dpad.guideAction: Press the directional buttons (Up ⬆️, Right ➡️, Down ⬇️, Left ⬅️) in sequence.
dpad.guideTip: Crucial for fighting games and combo executions.

triggers.label: Triggers & Bumpers
triggers.description: Test L1, R1 bumpers and analog precision of L2, R2 triggers
triggers.guideAction: Click L1 and R1 buttons, then pull L2 and R2 triggers all the way (100%).
triggers.guidePass: Register L1/R1 clicks and pull L2/R2 triggers above 90%.
triggers.guideTip: Failing to reach 100% prevents full acceleration in racing games.

sticks.label: Sticks & Drift
sticks.description: Test L3/R3 clicks, 360° circularity, and stick drift percentage
sticks.guideAction: Release sticks for zero-point reading, then rotate both 360° and click L3/R3.
sticks.guidePass: Complete full rotation on both sticks and click L3 and R3.
sticks.guideTip: Drift under 10% is excellent; above 15% indicates analog module service is needed.

gyro.label: 3D Gyroscope
gyro.description: Test 6-axis motion sensor and gyroscope with interactive 3D model
gyro.guideAction: Rotate the controller in 3D space to synchronize with the 3D model.
gyro.guidePass: Register motion sensor telemetry from gyroscope.
gyro.guideTip: Xbox controllers lack a gyroscope and can skip this step.

vibration.label: Vibration Motors
vibration.description: Test light and heavy haptic rumble motors
vibration.guideAction: Click 'Send Vibration Test' to feel rumble in both grips.
vibration.guidePass: Feel vibration and click 'Confirm Vibration & Continue'.
vibration.guideTip: If vibration is unavailable over Bluetooth, connect via USB cable.

mic.label: Microphone Test
mic.description: Test built-in controller microphone and measure decibel level
mic.guideAction: Click start test and speak near controller until the audio meter turns green.
mic.guidePass: Register sound level fluctuations or skip with 'Skip Step'.
mic.guideTip: Internal microphone is exclusive to PS5 controllers; others may skip.

report.label: Health Report
report.description: Controller health certification, technical score out of 100, and printout
report.guideAction: Review detailed technical health report and scores.
report.guidePass: Review technical certificate scored out of 100.
report.guideTip: A score above 85 indicates the controller is ready for competitive gaming.
